PeriodId.description:
Identifier for a Gregorian period like `2025Q1` or a fiscal period like
`FY2025W53`.

description: Target node, period and value, driver node and period, model write-back flag and optional bracket of a `goal_seek` solve.

bounds.description:
Optional `(lower, upper)` bracket, in the driver node's units, that
constrains the search; both ends must be finite and `lower < upper`.
`None` (the default) searches outward from the driver's current value.

driver_node.description: Node identifier of the driver input the solve varies.

driver_period.description: Period whose driver value the solve varies.

target_node.description: Node identifier of the target metric.

target_period.description: Period in which the target is evaluated.

target_value.description:
Desired value of the target metric, in the target node's units; must
be finite.

update_model.description:
When `true`, [`GoalSeekResult::model`] holds a copy of the model with
the solved driver value written in; when `false` it is `None`.

title: GoalSeekSpec
